subject: infra.energy
name: Data-centre power arrangements
what_would_settle_it: this subject is effectively empty for the country; probed 2026-08-05, no power purchase or supply arrangement is published; an analyst market brief maps the facilities and their power constraints

subject: dpi.id
name: Ghana Card payment functionality
what_would_settle_it: probed 2026-08-05, trade press reported an activated card wallet in early April 2026 and the issuing authority denied it on 8 April 2026

subject: digital.localgov
name: Local government electronic services
what_would_settle_it: a district service platform, or a local-government digitisation report, would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, the ministry's programme-based estimates document the district data platform and MMDA integration

subject: data.open
name: National open-data instrument
what_would_settle_it: a published policy or a live inventory would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, the 2016 open data policy located; the live inventory exists separately; the 2016 policy acquired on 2026-08-05 turned out to be the GHEITI extractives policy, not a national instrument, so a national open-data instrument remains unestablished

subject: geopol.india
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Ghana-India technology cooperation instrument
what_would_settle_it: a bilateral memorandum, a line-of-credit record or an Indian vendor contract would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, a joint trade committee discussed a possible digital MoU in May 2024; no signed instrument was located

subject: geopol.gulf
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Ghana-Gulf technology investment instrument
what_would_settle_it: a sovereign-fund agreement, or a data-centre or AI memorandum, would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, the May 2025 innovation hub memorandum is reported with a component breakdown but its text is not published

subject: include.divides
name: Community network licensing framework
what_would_settle_it: a civil-society policy lead places four other African states ahead of Ghana on enabling frameworks; probed 2026-08-05, no dedicated community-network licence exists; the authorised-ISP list defines the classes such a network must fit

subject: capacity.training
name: Distance-learning loan for tertiary institutions
what_would_settle_it: connects satellite campuses to fibre; borrowing terms unknown; probed 2026-08-05, the loan agreement is unpublished; terms appear only in a research database, which is a lead rather than a source

subject: capacity.training
name: Distance-learning loan for a local government institute
what_would_settle_it: the country announced sovereign default in December 2022; probed 2026-08-05, two attempts surfaced no distance-learning loan to a local-government institute
